Contractor will be given 4 weeks for bagging & transportation based on each shipment schedule. Communication vi de email will be given to contractor in this regard. If contractor fails to execute within given schedule, then LD will b e levied for the delay @ 0.5% of the contract value of delayed quantity per week or part of the week of delayed peri od, until actual delivery or performance, as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 5% of contract value of delayed q uantity. However, in case of inordinate delay maximum deduction shall be 10% of contract value of delayed quantit y. Here inordinate delay means when work is not completed within 24 weeks of its assignment (here 24 weeks calcul ated as 25% of total contract validity of 24 months). Note: Inexcusable delays of more than one-fourth (25%) of the completion period specified in the contr act shall be treated as inordinate delay(s). Minimum guarantee of quantity cannot be fixed as there is no assurance of receipt of minimum order per month. To tal quantity is estimated based on historical data. If the actual total quantities utilized at the end of the 24-month pe riod fall below the estimated BOQ volume, the contract will close based on actual payments made. No penalty, unde r-utilization fee, or shortfall compensation will be payable by contractor. Here failure to bag or transport as per schedule will be delay attributable to contractor.
